verdict_reasons: The matched workload grows from647 to1059 physical lines (57 to108 lexical declarations). Checker plus soundness, completeness, instances, tests and original-name facade alone is535 lines; five retained files cannot be counted as deleted.

checker.relation: Returns the unchanged actual Artifact type, preserving Artifact.source_to_model (every source horizon and full machine/caller frame), Artifact.model_to_source (every successful target run, zero skip and full final frame), normal_to_model and completion_iff.

checker.positive_controls: Actual source sequence with conditional branches; selected block accepted; semantically equivalent different-size selected output accepted. Concrete direct proofs use zero locals/depth. Existing two-local/depth13 controls replay symbolically through generic acceptance.
checker.negative_controls: Wrong appended push rejected and proved to have no Artifact; insufficient horizon, loops and unsupported SSTORE selection refused.
